name: Katya Perez-Milenkaya
source:
Raised in institutions and foster families, Nyx never found stability or anyone she could rely on. Her scionic ability, chaotic and unstable, distorts probability around her, triggering unlikely coincidences that intensify under stress and affect anyone nearby. Considered a public risk by COSA, she lives on the margins, surviving through sexual favors and petty crimes, and, as much as her power allows, tries to stay off the authorities' radar.
